title: Assessing Multilingual Fairness in Pre-trained Multimodal Representations

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the distance between text features across languages (multilingual individual fairness) and calculating the cross-lingual accuracy disparity in image-text matching and facial attribute classification tasks using the multilingual CLIP model.

Calculating the accuracy disparity between male and female groups in gender classification tasks on the FairFace dataset across 8 different languages, as well as analyzing how these gender gaps vary across different racial groups.

Evaluating the predictive accuracy and cross-lingual performance gaps in race classification across 7 racial groups using the FairFace dataset, and observing how intersectional gender gaps differ among these racial groups.

Measuring the predictive accuracy disparity in classifying 5 different age groups on the FairFace dataset across multiple languages, and analyzing the age classification accuracy differences between male and female groups.
